assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has atrial fibrillation coded as I48.91.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease coded as I25.10.
The patient has symptom code R55 indicating the syncope.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded as CPT 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The service is medically necessary to detect intermittent cardiac events that cannot be captured during in-office evaluation.
The indication's stated purpose is correlating these intermittent symptoms with arrhythmias.
